tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page: Ludum's cream stock (in Press, the black field). Every surface and module sits on it; texture never goes under running text.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: The second stock: alternate bands, a catalogue row on hover, table stripes, the field behind a note's margin rail.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The raised sheet: fields, a certificate's face, a figure's mount. Never shadowed; set apart by `rule-strong`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Press black (in Press, the cream): text, display type, the frame's bars and rules, ink buttons. 16.9:1 on `paper`, 18.4:1 on `sheet`, 14.9:1 on `paper-2`; the same in Press.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: deks, standfirsts, a catalogue entry's description, long captions. 10:1 on `paper`, 8.8:1 on `paper-2`; 9.7:1 on Press `paper`.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: The apparatus at rest: metadata values, dates, byline, inactive tabs. 5.7:1 on `paper`, 5.0:1 on `paper-2`; 5.5:1 on Press `paper-2`. Not for long reading.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines (1px) between rows of a table, a ledger or a list. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Every structural rule: the 2px rules between modules, the 4px rules over a masthead's metadata, control borders. It is `ink`.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The black frame in both themes: the navigation bar, the footer, a table's head row, the wordmark's block. Text on it is `on-frame`; in Press it sits on `paper`, set off below by the Neta line (`neta-pink` → `neta-cyan`).

tokens.name: on-frame
tokens.usage: Text, links and the wordmark on `frame`. 16.9:1. The focus ring on `frame` is `yellow` (12:1).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Signal red, Ludum's first pigment: primary buttons, the PLAYABLE stamp, the red sun, display words picked out on a headline, 1830's numerals. Large type and fills only (4.3:1 on `paper`); small red text is `red-ink`.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `red` fill: primary buttons, the PLAYABLE stamp. 4.7:1.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: Red for small text: a picked-out word in body or labels, a link's hover on `paper`. 5.0:1 on `paper`, 4.7:1 on `sheet`; Press 7.1:1.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Yellow pigment: the IN DEVELOPMENT stamp, 18xx yellow tiles, highlighter bars, the focus ring in Press. A fill or a mark on dark grounds; never text on `paper`.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text on a `yellow` fill. 12:1.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Blue pigment: the EXPERIMENTAL stamp, blueprint linework, a second route on a map. Fills, rules and large type (4.5:1 on `paper`); small blue text is `blue-ink`.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on a `blue` fill. 4.9:1.

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Blue for small text and links in diagrams' labels. 5.6:1 on `paper`; Press 8.8:1.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Green pigment: the RESEARCH stamp, 18xx green tiles. Fills and large type (4.4:1 on `paper`).

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on a `green` fill. 4.8:1.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Archive grey: the ARCHIVE stamp, 18xx grey tiles, retired entries. A fill with `ink` text (5.4:1).

tokens.name: on-grey
tokens.usage: Text on a `grey` fill: the ARCHIVE stamp. 5.4:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 3px solid ring, offset 3px, on everything that takes focus. `ink` on the stock (16.9:1), `yellow` in Press (12:1).

tokens.name: neta-pink
tokens.usage: Neta DAO's pink, the start of the Neta line (pink → cyan, the bar in Neta DAO's mark). Used only where Ludum meets its parent: the rule under the nav, the byline's bar, the footer's band, PLAY's hover. A mark on `frame` (6.1:1), never text on `paper` (2.8:1).

tokens.name: neta-cyan
tokens.usage: Neta DAO's cyan, the end of the Neta line, and PLAY's fill: play.netadao.org is Neta DAO's, and netadao.org already opens Play in cyan. `on-neta` text on it (9.8:1); 9.8:1 as a mark on `frame`. On `paper` it carries a 2px `frame` edge, since cyan alone reads 1.7:1 there.

tokens.name: on-neta
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `neta-cyan` (9.8:1) and `neta-pink` (6.1:1) fills: PLAY at rest and on hover.

tokens.name: p1830-stock
tokens.usage: 1830: Juno Edition's ground, a share certificate's warmer stock. `ink` on it 15.9:1, `red-ink` 4.7:1.

tokens.name: p1830-red
tokens.usage: 1830's accent: the numerals, the red sun, the president's certificate. It is Ludum's `red`.

tokens.name: p1830-coal
tokens.usage: 1830's black: locomotive, track, the stripe band.

tokens.name: p1830-tile-yellow
tokens.usage: 18xx tile phase 1, yellow: on 1830's maps and charts.

tokens.name: p1830-tile-green
tokens.usage: 18xx tile phase 2, green.

tokens.name: p1830-tile-brown
tokens.usage: 18xx tile phase 3, brown. Cream text on it 6:1.

tokens.name: p1830-tile-grey
tokens.usage: 18xx tile phase 4, grey.

tokens.name: p20c-night
tokens.usage: 20 Cosmos's ground: a blue-black operating chart, not outer space. Cream on it 15.4:1.

tokens.name: p20c-cream
tokens.usage: 20 Cosmos's ink and its light zones: titles, nodes, the ledger's paper.

tokens.name: p20c-mist
tokens.usage: 20 Cosmos's secondary copy on `p20c-night` (9:1).

tokens.name: p20c-yellow
tokens.usage: 20 Cosmos's signal: the numerals 20, the hub's links, the highlighter behind its themes.

tokens.name: p20c-blue
tokens.usage: 20 Cosmos's zone blue: filled zones and certificates' engraving.

tokens.name: p20c-line
tokens.usage: Routes and linework on `p20c-night` (6.7:1).

tokens.name: p20c-red
tokens.usage: 20 Cosmos's rival line: a competing route, used once per diagram.

styles.name: d0
styles.usage: Poster: a project masthead's numerals and the homepage's game titles. 196 laptop, 156 tablet, 112 phone (crops at the edge when the composition wants it). Uppercase, Anton, nothing else on the line.

styles.name: d1
styles.usage: Headline: a page title (PROJECTS, NOTES, WHY GAMES), the statement band. 120 / 96 / 72.

styles.name: d2
styles.usage: Section: a section head inside a page, a note's title. 76 / 64 / 52.

styles.name: d3
styles.usage: Feature: a catalogue entry's title, a pull quote, the mechanics stack. 48 / 44 / 38.

styles.name: d4
styles.usage: Title: a note entry, a module head, a table's caption head. 32 / 30 / 28.

styles.name: d5
styles.usage: Small display: the nav, a stamp's word at large size, card-level heads. 24 / 22 / 22.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: A deck under a title, a project's opening paragraph. 19/28 on phones.
styles.sample: Ludum publishes games as objects, events and systems to enter.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text in notes and on project pages, 60–68 characters a line. 17/28 on phones.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Descriptions in catalogue and note entries, footnotes, the footer.

styles.name: nav-m
styles.usage: Mono navigation and tab labels, uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, kickers, metadata keys, button text at small size: always uppercase.

styles.name: label-s
styles.usage: Micro labels: legends, figure numbers, the frame's index marks.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Metadata values, table cells, dates, captions in sentence case.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: a stamp's inner frame, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside labels and stamps; between a kicker and its title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked labels; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone margins and gutters; padding in small modules.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; padding in buttons' sides; between a title and its dek.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a module.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Module padding on desktop; desktop page margins at 1440.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between modules.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Above a page title; masthead padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: fields, buttons, stamps, images, panels. Print has no rounded corners.

tokens.name: radius-token
tokens.usage: Only for drawn game pieces and the red circle: tokens, stations, the hub.

rule.note: Rule weights. Rules are always `rule-strong` (ink) except hairlines (`rule`).

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines between table rows and list items (`rule`).

tokens.name: rule-2
tokens.usage: Module edges, control borders, the rule over a section head (`rule-strong`).

tokens.name: rule-4
tokens.usage: Over a masthead's metadata strip and under the nav's current item.

tokens.name: rule-bar
tokens.usage: The 8px bar: above the next-note band; the footer's Neta band is this weight.

tokens.name: rule-band
tokens.usage: The band: a stripe or pigment band along a project field.

tokens.name: frame-max
tokens.usage: The frame's widest; mastheads and fields bleed past it to the window edge.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The reading column of a note (about 64 characters of `body`).

tokens.name: grid-cols
tokens.usage: Columns at tablet and up; 4 on phones.

tokens.name: margin-desktop
tokens.usage: Page margin at 1280 and up.

tokens.name: margin-laptop
tokens.usage: Page margin from 1024.

tokens.name: margin-tablet
tokens.usage: Page margin from 600.

tokens.name: margin-phone
tokens.usage: Page margin under 600.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: The black navigation bar's height (56 on phones).

timing.note: Motion: few, hard, purposeful. All of it stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: dur-wipe
tokens.usage: A hard wipe: a button or a catalogue row filling on hover.

tokens.name: dur-print
tokens.usage: A print reveal: a masthead or figure entering once as it scrolls into view.

tokens.name: dur-draw
tokens.usage: A route line drawing itself, once.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: Wipes and reveals: fast in the middle, a hard stop.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Colour and positional shifts on hover.
